mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it showed how nerves and blood routes connect the regions and support the same muscles.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the digestive and urinary organs into their named slots was clear but predictable; there was little to figure out beyond matching the slots.

surprise.text: The final model kept the small repaired scar rather than treating the repaired segment as the entire skin covering.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The named slots and goals explained the placements, though some choices were mainly following those instructions rather than solving a problem.

continue.text: I would probably try another chapter if it explored a new connection. This ending brought the systems together clearly, but several assembly steps were predictable.
